product_metadata.title: TOPPIN Bendable Corded Stick Vacuum Cleaner - 600W 17kpa Powerful Suction Lightweight Handheld Vacuum, 0.8L Cup, Perfect for Pet Hair Hard Floor Home Deep Clean
features: 17kpa Powerful Suction: Equipped with an advanced 600W high power motor, perfect for hard floors, marble, tiles. A wider suction mouth allows it to simply suck in hair without entanglement. (Note: not suitable for carpet)

Easy to Use: With the foldable tube, swivel steering and a lay flat handle, TOPPIN stick vacuum cleaner maneuvers under and around furniture with ease. It's easy for the elderly and those with joint pain to clean hard-to-reach areas without bending over.

4 Stages Fully-sealed Filtration: Using air outlet sponge, MIF, honeycomb, providing pure air for your family. Regular cleaning of filters is necessary to prevent weak suction and clogging. (Note: Reuse when all parts are clean and dry).
Regular cleaning: Regular cleaning of filters is necessary to prevent weak suction and clogging. (Note: Reuse when all parts are clean and dry).

Large Cup & Easy to Clean: Plus the super long 7m power cord, the 0.8L large-capacity dust cup allows you to clean more area at once. Emptying is easy. Press the button under the cup and you can empty it without smudging your hands.
